title: Feature Scaling in ML Step 1: Why It's Crucial for Data Preprocessing

cues.en: Instructor: Hello and welcome to this almost final tutorial of the part one data preprocessing.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到第一部分資料前處理的倒數幾堂課。

cues.en: I look forward to being well prepared with our data to start making our machine learning models.
cues.zh: 我很期待把資料準備好，正式開始建立模型。

cues.en: It's gonna be very fun.
cues.zh: 那會非常有趣。

cues.en: We just have to hold on for two more tutorials and then we're good to go.
cues.zh: 再完成兩堂課，就準備好了。

cues.en: Okay, so today we're gonna talk about feature scaling, which is very important in machine learning.
cues.zh: 今天要談的是機器學習中非常重要的特徵縮放。

cues.en: I'm going to explain you why right now.
cues.zh: 現在解釋原因。

cues.en: So I'm gonna go to Google Sheets to find our data set, and here it is.
cues.zh: 到 Google Sheets 找到資料集，就是這裡。

cues.en: Let's explain what is feature scaling and why we need to do it.
cues.zh: 說明特徵縮放是什麼，以及為什麼需要它。

cues.en: Okay, so as you can see, we have these two columns, age and salary that contains numerical numbers.
cues.zh: 可以看到，Age 與 Salary 這兩欄包含數值。

cues.en: Let's just focus on the age and the salary.
cues.zh: 先專注在年齡與薪資。

cues.en: You notice that the variables are not on the same scale because the age are going from 27 to 50
cues.zh: 你會注意到，兩個變數的尺度不同，年齡從 27 到 50，

cues.en: and the salary is going from 40K to like 90K.
So because this age variable and the salary variable don't have the same scale, this will cause some issues in your machine learning models.
cues.zh: 由於尺度不同，就會在機器學習模型中造成一些問題。

cues.en: And why is that?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: It's because your machine learning models, a lot of machine learning models are based on what is called the Euclidean distance.
cues.zh: 因為許多模型是以所謂的歐幾里得距離為基礎。

cues.en: If you remember that back from high school, the Euclidean distance between two data points, between two points, is the square root of the sum of the squared coordinates.
cues.zh: 如果還記得高中數學，兩點間的歐幾里得距離，是各座標差平方和的平方根。

cues.en: Well, actually, here it's the same.
cues.zh: 這裡也是相同概念。

cues.en: We have two variables, age and salary.
cues.zh: 我們有兩個變數：年齡與薪資。

cues.en: So you can picture age as the x-coordinate and the salary as the y-coordinate.
cues.zh: 可以把年齡想成 x 座標，薪資想成 y 座標。

cues.en: And in the machine learning models equations, some Euclidean distances between observation points, for example, this one and this one, are computed based on these two coordinates.
cues.zh: 機器學習模型會根據這兩個座標，計算觀測點之間的歐幾里得距離，例如這兩筆資料。

cues.en: And actually, since the salary has a much wider range of values because it's going from zero to 100K,
cues.zh: 薪資的數值範圍大很多，大約從 0 到 100,000，

cues.en: the Euclidean distance will be dominated by the salary because, for example, if we take two observations, for example, this one, the ninth one, and the third one.
cues.zh: 因此距離會被薪資主導。以第九筆與第三筆觀測值為例。

cues.en: Well, the Euclidean distance will compute the difference between this salary and this salary.
cues.zh: 歐幾里得距離會先計算這兩個薪資的差。

cues.en: So let's compute it.
cues.zh: 來算一下。

cues.en: That's about, okay, so this minus this one, as you can see, this is 31,000.
cues.zh: 這個減這個，可以看到是 31,000。

cues.en: If you put that in square.
cues.zh: 再把它平方。

cues.en: Okay, let's see, up square, that gives this.
cues.zh: 平方後得到這個數值。

cues.en: And now let's take for the same two observations, the ages.
cues.zh: 現在取同樣兩筆觀測值的年齡。

cues.en: So let's compute equals 48 minus, it was this one, right, 27.
cues.zh: 計算 48 減去 27，對，就是這一筆。

cues.en: Okay, that's the difference.
cues.zh: 這就是年齡差。

cues.en: And now let's take this square equals this square, 441.
cues.zh: 再平方，得到 441。

cues.en: So you can see very clearly how this square difference dominates this square difference.
cues.zh: 很清楚，這個平方差遠遠大於另一個平方差。

cues.en: And that's because these two variables are not on the same scale.
cues.zh: 原因就是兩個變數的尺度不同。

cues.en: So you know, in the machine learning equations, it will be like this doesn't exist because it will be dominated by this.
cues.zh: 在模型的方程式中，較小的差異幾乎像不存在一樣，因為被較大的差異蓋過。

cues.en: So that's why we absolutely need to put the variables on the same scale.
cues.zh: 所以必須把變數調到相同尺度。

cues.en: That is that we are gonna transform these two variables and they're gonna have values in the same range.
cues.zh: 也就是轉換這兩個變數，讓它們的值位於相同範圍。

cues.en: For example, they're gonna have values from minus one to plus one here, and same here, minus one to plus one.
cues.zh: 例如這邊落在 -1 到 +1，另一邊也落在 -1 到 +1。

cues.en: So that we don't get this sort of problem with a huge number here dominating a smaller number here, so that eventually the smaller number doesn't exist.
cues.zh: 避免這裡的大數字主導小數字，讓小數字幾乎沒有影響。

cues.en: There are several ways of scaling your data.
cues.zh: 縮放資料有幾種方式。

cues.en: A very common one is the standardization, which means that for each observation and each feature, you withdraw the mean value of all the values of the feature, and you divide it by the standard deviation.
cues.zh: 常見的是標準化，對每個特徵的每筆觀測值，減去該特徵的平均數，再除以標準差。

cues.en: So that's the first type of feature scaling.
cues.zh: 這是第一種特徵縮放方式。

cues.en: And another type is normalization, which means that you subtract your observation feature x by the minimum value of all the feature values and you divide it by the difference
cues.zh: 另一種是正規化，將特徵值 x 減去該特徵的最小值，再除以

cues.en: between the maximum of your feature values and the minimum of your future values.
cues.zh: 該特徵最大值與最小值的差。

cues.en: Don't worry if you're not very comfortable with the mathematics here, but what you need to understand is that we are putting our variables in the same range, in the same scale so that no variable
cues.zh: 如果對這裡的數學不熟，先別擔心。重點是把變數放在相同範圍與尺度，避免某個變數

cues.en: is dominated by the other.
cues.zh: 被另一個變數主導。

cues.en: Okay, so let's do it right now.
cues.zh: 現在開始操作。

cues.en: Anyway, you're gonna see how the variables are gonna be transformed.
cues.zh: 稍後就能看到變數如何轉換。

cues.en: You're gonna see how they go from having large and very different values to small and same values.
cues.zh: 它們會從很大、差異明顯的數值，轉成比較小、尺度相同的數值。

cues.en: So let's move on to R.
cues.zh: 回到 R。
